summary.intent: Debug BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging by tracing the load test workload through the API validation and BYO mode check pipeline.
summary.outcome: Discovered setByoStatus() was a dead service method with no controller endpoint (causing 403, not 400), added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint, fixed load test ipns-publish to use proper signed records via createAndPublishIpnsRecord, fixed 9 pre-existing API test files with broken mock typing, and merged PR #400. Also cleaned up a Entire CLI husky hook that shouldn't have been committed.

repo: setByoStatus() in VaultService was a dead code path — service method existed but no controller endpoint was ever wired up, meaning BYO mode could never be enabled via API
The load test's ipns-publish step was sending { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — the signed IPNS record is mandatory
API test files use jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> pattern which loses mock method types after module.get() — all must use the mock variable directly, not the module.get() result
orval generates new model files into packages/api-client/src/ that must all be staged — partial staging of api-client breaks the barrel index
The todo done/ copy and pending/ copy both made it into main because the merge brought both files; stale pending entries must be cleaned up after merges
The .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire file is a local Entire CLI artifact and should be in .git/info/exclude, not committed to the repo

code.finding: New PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint added; previously setByoStatus was unreachable from any HTTP route
SetByoStatusRequestDto (isByoUser: boolean) and SetByoStatusResponseDto (isByoUser, vaultId) added

Centralized STREAMING_MIME_TYPES, CTR_SIZE_THRESHOLD, selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size), and normalizeEncryptionMode() — previously duplicated in sdk/client.ts and apps/web streaming-crypto.service.ts
createByoClientPool must call PATCH /vault/byo-status for each account after pool creation; filter out any accounts where enablement fails and throw if zero succeed
createSdkContext was being called inside the per-iteration loop — should be hoisted outside; ipns-publish must use createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core to produce valid signed records

workflow: When staging api-client generated files, always stage the entire packages/api-client/src/ directory to avoid missing barrel index references

When adding new exports to sdk-core, all SDK test files that mock @cipherbox/sdk-core with a bare factory must be updated to use importOriginal + spread, otherwise the new export is undefined at runtime
The Entire CLI modifies .husky/commit-msg locally and creates .husky/commit-msg.pre-entire; both should be in .git/info/exclude to prevent showing in diffs

friction: orval API client regeneration requires the API server to be running with the latest build; running it against a stale server produces incomplete model files
GraphQL review thread resolution timed out; had to fall back to REST for fetching and work around the GraphQL endpoint separately
Pre-existing API test errors across 9+ files caused significant typecheck noise unrelated to the actual feature work
Manual OpenAPI spec generation wrote to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json, adding a 3889-line file to the PR diff
Entire CLI hook committed to repo when it should have stayed local — required a follow-up commit to remove it and restore the original commitlint hook
open_items: integration.test.ts in packages/sdk has pre-existing failures hitting live API endpoints — not fixed, needs investigation
BYO load test baselines on staging still need to be run now that the 403 bug is fixed (todo #11 moved to done but actual baseline capture deferred)
The streaming-playback E2E test previously skipped for CTR badge is now unskipped — should monitor for flakiness in CI
